title: NirmatAI → DTP flow (Bulk audit)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 02 Nov 2026 · Prepared by QA
intro: Steps 1 and 2 happen in NirmatAI, which has no screen in DTP. Screenshots use existing test data. Red boxes and labels were added for this document.

steps.what: Create standard A in the NirmatAI org.
steps.result: Standard exists but is not ready: DTP does not see it.
body: NirmatAI creates the standard and its work products. While it is not ready, Sync from NirmatAI in DTP skips it.

steps.what: Turn the standard on (ready and active).
steps.result: Standard is ready: the next Sync in DTP picks it up.
body: DTP reads only standards that are both active and ready. Nothing changes in DTP until an SGS Admin runs Sync.
On the DTP side, the NirmatAI integration must be on (SGS Portal > Integration > NirmatAI).
shots: SGS Portal > Integration > NirmatAI: the integration is on, so DTP can sync from NirmatAI.

steps.result: New framework NAI-<standard id>, source NirmatAI, status Draft.
body: The code is always NAI- followed by the NirmatAI standard ID (for example NAI-107), so two synced frameworks never share a code.
shots: Frameworks list filtered by "NAI": Sync from NirmatAI button and the synced frameworks.

steps.what: Check the name and work products, then Activate.
steps.result: Framework is Activated: customers can pick it for a Bulk workspace.
body: Only Activated frameworks are offered to customers.
shots: NAI-107 detail: status Activated, 35 work products from NirmatAI.

steps.what: Create workspace > Create Bulk workspace: scope, then the NAI-xxx standard, then details.
body: Step 2 lists only NirmatAI frameworks that SGS has activated. A scope can have only one active workspace per standard.
shots: Create workspace menu: Create Bulk workspace.
Step 2: choose the standard (only activated NirmatAI frameworks).
Step 3: workspace name (optional); the cycle starts today and runs three years.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Bulk workspace > Open documents
steps.what: Upload files, map them to work products, Request audit.
steps.result: Request is Waiting for approval; documents are locked.
body: Mapping to work products is optional. After Request audit, the customer can still upload new versions and add them to the request.
shots: Documents page after Request audit: banner "Audit requested", files mapped to work products.

steps.what: Open the request, link the NirmatAI client, Approve and send.
steps.result: DTP creates the audit in NirmatAI and sends the files.
body: Approve and send stays disabled until a NirmatAI client is linked. The client can be changed until documents are sent.
shots: Requests > Bulk workspaces: requests waiting for approval.
Request detail: NirmatAI client and Approve and send.
Approve and send to NirmatAI dialog.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Bulk request; Customer Portal > Sent documents
steps.what: NirmatAI processes the files; DTP checks their status.
steps.result: Request Under review; each file Waiting to process, Processing, Ready or Failed.
body: SGS Admin sees the status of each file from NirmatAI. The customer sees only whether each document was sent or failed.
shots: Sent request: status Under review, NirmatAI audit code and the list of sends.
Documents of the request: status from NirmatAI (here all Ready).

tables.heading: Document status from NirmatAI
rows: NirmatAI received the file but has not started. If it stays more than 15 minutes, DTP triggers it again, up to 3 times.
Processing failed. The line under the label says what the customer sees: "Processing failed" or "Conversion failed".

limitations: The test environment uses a mock sign-in. On the SGS environment users sign in through Microsoft Entra.
On the test environment all email goes to Mailpit, not real inboxes.
blocked: NirmatAI connection on the SGS environment
Sync from NirmatAI, Approve and send, status updates from NirmatAI.
The NirmatAI certificate is not yet installed on the SGS environment; the flow was run on the LTS test environment only.
After the certificate is installed: Sync, Approve and send, and file statuses reaching Ready.
Creating and enabling a standard in NirmatAI.
Done by NirmatAI (Usman); DTP has no screen for it.
NirmatAI confirms the standard is ready before SGS runs Sync.
Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Each role can sign in to its portal through Entra.
On the test environment all mail goes to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Emails arrive, links in them open the right page.
